svg.title: IPAWCUS Level 1 Data Flow Diagram
svg.desc: FigJam-importable IPAWCUS data-flow diagram with editable vector shapes and text.

text.tspan: Nine system processes with shared logical stores and individually labeled external data flows
EXTERNAL ENTITY | PROCESS | DATA STORE | EXTERNAL ENTITY
Rectangle = external entity Rounded box = process Open-ended box = logical data store Arrow label = data moved
User, Profile, Role and Branch Access Data
Queue, Visit and Clinical Record Data
Branch, Service, Room and Inventory Data
